visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man in a black tank top and hoodie is in a well-lit kitchen. He is meticulously pouring white powder from a large, dark bag into a small, clear resealable bag placed on a silver digital scale. The camera zooms in on his hands and the scale. (2) The man stands outside under bright sunlight, wearing a backpack and holding a smartphone. He walks towards the entrance of a yellow building with a prominent red circular sign that reads 'POWERHOUSE GYM'. He looks at the camera and points towards the building. (3) Inside the gym, the man is seen from several angles performing a heavy chest press exercise on a machine, wearing elbow wraps. He smiles and points towards posters of bodybuilders on the walls while talking to the camera. He interacts briefly with a gym staff member or another member. (4) The man exits the gym building, carrying his bag, and walks across the asphalt parking lot as the sun sets, casting long shadows. He looks back at the building one last time before the video ends.
